newsitem.title: USA: Sextuplets born in New York area hospital.
newsitem.headline: Sextuplets born in New York area hospital.

text.p: A rare set of sextuplets has been born at a New York hospital, a hospital spokeswoman said on Thursday.

The four girls and two boys were born last week at University Hospital in Stony Brook, N.Y., the Daily News reported. The hospital could confirm the births but provide no details at the request of the family and their attorney, the spokeswoman said.

The babies were born by Caesarean delivery and weigh about two pounds (0.9 kg) each, the newspaper said. There was no information available on their condition, and they are being cared for at the hospital in incubators, it said.

The parents, from the New York City borough of Queens, were registered at the hospital under an alias, the newspaper said. It was not known if the mother had taken fertility drugs, which can be the cause of multiple births.
Another set of sextuplets, four boys and two girls, was born to a Chatham, New York, couple last year and celebrated their first birthday on March 22.
